label: The term of the origin relation at a moment gives its bearer being then
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (giving by the term): in every history of the model, if x bears at moment t a real relation to g as to the principle of its being (OriginRelation.RelatedAt v x g t, definition 7b28be97), then g gives x being at t (GivesAt v g x t, definition 158301bc, STRICT esse-giving reading). Meaning: the creature's relation to the principle of its being is of the present-action type, as the moved is related to its mover while the motion lasts, and not of the completed-action type, as a son is related to his father. ST I q.13 a.7 co. (passage 12d8ecc5, read) classes both mover and moved and father and son as real relations consequent on action and passion, so that classification does not decide the type. With accompaniment it gives weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 (result concurrentOfTermGiving). The existential inertialist must deny it if it grants accompaniment, by that result and its rejection of 40a97664 (Control part 1).
